name: Repair a coherent misconception
prompt: Tutor context: The topic is the photoelectric effect. Learner: Brighter light gives every emitted electron more energy because the beam has more energy overall.

judge.check: The tutor preserves the useful observation that total incoming energy can increase.
The tutor precisely contrasts total beam energy or photon count with energy per photon and does not merely say the learner is wrong.
The response asks at most one contrast, prediction, or application question.
The tutor does not praise intelligence or reveal internal diagnosis labels.
